the ancient Lion Capital of Ashoka preserved at

Which of the following statements regarding the official State symbols of Telangana is correct?
options_english: The State Animal is the Gaur and the State Bird is the House Sparrow.

The State Tree is the Jammi Chettu and the State Flower is the Tangedu.

questions.explanation_english: The State Tree is the Jammi Chettu and the State Flower is the Tangedu. The State Government of Telangana designated its official state symbols following the formation of the state in 2014. The Jammi Chettu (Prosopis cineraria) was officially chosen as the State Tree due to its cultural importance during the Dasara festival. Simultaneously, the Tangedu flower (Senna auriculata) was selected as the State Flower because of its prominent role in the traditional Bathukamma floral festival celebrated across the region.
